value.name: HBO crew films Dicky smoking crack
value.description: An HBO crew records Dicky in a filthy crack house as he smokes crack and talks to the camera while high.
evidence: HBO crew filming Dicky smoking crack, Bic lighter in his hand, leaning against half of an old dining-room table in a filthy kitchen, faded strawberry wallpaper.
DICKY (mumbling fast to camera, high out of his mind)

value.name: Dicky blames others for his missed opportunity
value.description: Dicky complains that people around him did not understand the opportunity and says he was brought along too early before fighting Sugar Ray.
evidence: They didn't understand. They're practically my gang, they usually listen to me but didn't understand the opportunity, anyway, where were WE--
Oh, yeah, all the money I coulda made if we just fuckin' did it RIGHT, they threw me in too early. We didn't know, my mothah didn't know, Sugar Ray was too much, too soon.

value.name: Dicky imagines a better career with discipline
value.description: Dicky says he needed to build slowly and claims that if he had Micky's discipline and his own talent, he would have succeeded greatly.
evidence: I needed to build slow. If I had Micky's discipline, with my talent, forget about it.

value.name: Dicky mentions family pride
value.description: Dicky brings up his wife and daughter, saying he wants his daughter to be proud of him.
evidence: My wife Debbie was the prettiest girl in Lowell, and my daughtah Kasie, I mean Kerry, I want Kerry to be proud a me.

value.name: Karen questions the filming
value.description: Karen asks why Dicky is letting them film him smoking crack and what the movie is about.
evidence: KAREN Why you let them film you smokin'? What this movie about again?

value.name: Producer explains the crack documentary
value.description: The HBO producer explains that the film is about crack addiction and is meant to show kids what it really does.
evidence: HBO PRODUCER I told you it's about crack addiction. Showing what can happen, what it really is, so kids can see it for real.

value.name: BooBoo starts explaining crack
value.description: BooBoo begins to offer an explanation of how crack works in the brain.
evidence: BOOBOO I can tell ya about the way it works in the brain--

value.name: Dicky interrupts and reclaims the story
value.description: Dicky cuts BooBoo off, insists it is still his movie, and says the crack scene will make his and Micky's comeback more dramatic.
evidence: DICKY Excuse me, BooBoo, it's still my movie, and this part [lights pipe] will make me and Micky's comeback more dramatic.

value.name: Dicky inhales crack again
value.description: Dicky lights the pipe and inhales, continuing his crack use as he promises to explain how it works.
evidence: [lights pipe] will make me and Micky's comeback more dramatic. I'll tell ya how crack works [inhales from pipe].
